reviews.text: Excellent service.

We love the service and the professionals at AZP. Every time we have an issue with either our cat or our dog, we are treated with great attention and care. They are excellent professionals who clearly love what they do.
Professionals and animal lovers

We booked an appointment for 11:00. It's now 11:34 and we still haven't been seen, without any information about the delay.

Unfortunately, this isn't the first time this has happened. It's a demonstration of total disrespect for clients' time. If the clinic can't keep to scheduled appointments, it would be fair to inform clients in advance.

A very unpleasant experience. I hope management will pay more attention to the organization of service and respect for clients.
The service is wonderful, Regina is very attentive. I'm already a member and I highly recommend it; my kitten is being very well taken care of.
They are very empathetic! I really like their service.

As new members of the Portuguese Zoophilic Association, we used the clinic for the neutering of our male dog and we couldn't be more satisfied. The service was spectacular at every stage: from the rigorous pre-appointment process to the day of surgery. I would like to highlight the excellent communication and helpful telephone assistance during the post-operative period. My enormous gratitude to the entire team of healthcare professionals, not forgetting the fantastic cleaning team that keeps the facilities spotless. An excellent service.

The treatment our dog has received has been excellent.

The prices are also affordable compared to what I was used to paying.
Very good hospital with excellent veterinarians.
From the medical team to all the administrative staff, they are always very helpful and attentive. I highly recommend them 🙂
Excellent. Truly fantastic people.

Since I decided to live in Lisbon and because I have a dog, I got to know the AZP clinic and became a member. I always schedule appointments, last month I took my dog ​​for the multivalent vaccine and scheduled the second dose for today, June 2nd, 2026 at 10:30 am. We arrived ten minutes early as usual, I told the receptionist who listened, asked the animal's name and said nothing. We waited, all the animals that arrived after us went in ahead of us, I asked and the answer was that my dog ​​would be next. More than an hour passed and I went back to ask what was happening, she told me that she had squeezed me in and that I wasn't scheduled. In the end, I asked if she had told me that when I arrived and she said no. Incompetence and lack of respect for others. Apparently, the appointment was not registered and nothing was said when I arrived either. The clinic has many veterinarians, there is a young veterinarian who is attentive and competent.

Lamentable.

I can only express my gratitude to Mrs. Tania for helping me with my dog ​​Yurbi. She was diagnosed with pulmonary edema, and Mrs. Tania from the AZP hospital saw my distress and managed to get help for my dog ​​so she could be treated as quickly as possible. If it weren't for Mrs. Tania, perhaps my Yurbi wouldn't be here anymore. These are the professionals who truly love what they do. A huge thank you.
My cat is diabetic and they had what I needed.
I always have a very good experience! I highly recommend it.
Super PROFESSIONALS!
5-star staff, fast service!
Excellent professionals!

I don't even know where to begin to thank Ana and Fábio for the exceptional service I received. From the very beginning, they were attentive and explained everything I should do and how to do it with great care. When you work with animals, you need unconditional love, just like cats have for their owners, and honestly, because of the energy, kindness, and all the love they showed, regardless of whether I believe in saints or not, I was certain I was in the presence of two faithful followers of Saint Francis of Assisi. Thank you both for trying, in every way, to help save my cat's life in an accessible way, and for having that empathy and understanding that, at the moment, I couldn't pay for everything at once, scheduling a follow-up appointment so we could start with the medication, which I already brought home.

And I hope that Fábio, in addition to gaining the official title of excellent explainer, also has his salary increased—and that of all the other professionals as well—because, besides a lot of love for animals, a lot of patience is needed, both with them and with the owners who, sometimes out of desperation, can go a little overboard in their behavior (or at least I imagine so). I myself witnessed a scene of this kind before leaving the association, on the day I was there.

Ana and Fábio, thank you for your service. I hope your professional life is always full of success and good fortune. Gaya also greatly appreciates the attention, but doesn't appreciate the amount of medicine he has to take every day, but at least I didn't get fatal scratches giving him the IV fluids in the last few days. A big hug to all of you and I wish you a great week.

A big thank you to the whole team.
I highly recommend it!
Excellent service, exemplary.
Great staff
Excellent service. Great reception, excellent doctors, and very approachable. Very informative.
Excellent service
Super kind and attentive.
Even with limited resources, this Non-Profit excells in its mission.
I’ve been waiting for 40 minutes for an appointment I scheduled in advance, and no one informed me about the delay.

Contacting this Association (answering a call from them) is worse than trying to contact Joe Biden, now D. Trump, the US president.
In fact, either I'm a "sniper" or I always hit the mark when they're "busy".
And it's no use contesting or alerting the governing bodies:
"They will deeply regret it, promise to develop a quick response - it's been the same for 4 years - and offer their sincerest apologies."
Ms. Rosa Maria and Ms. Carla - just to mention two women - put the phone on silent, talk a mile a minute about this and that and about other people's lives, and for anyone who calls, the best thing to do is go there.

Perhaps the departure of some excellent Veterinary Doctors (Dr. Inez d'Almeida and Célia Ribeiro) is not unrelated to this way of working, to put an end to the Association.

A Member

António Couceiro

Today, I found Dr. Isabel Afonso to be attentive, kind, understanding, and sincere. She is a true professional, as well as a fantastic human being with a helpful spirit.
It's not easy to find someone like that.
My sincere thanks for the treatment I received.
Impeccable and attentive!

My cat was spayed at the AZP clinic 9 years ago, and today she underwent surgery at another clinic because they discovered a calcified plaque left over from that operation... She hasn't had any other surgical procedures, so it could only have happened during the spaying...
Since becoming a partner, I've only felt gratitude towards the team. My Tuti has always been treated with care and professionalism. May God continue to bless you all ❤️🙏 Ana Menezes …
The receptionist was friendly, but the appointment was made for a veterinarian who was there, but they changed the appointment to another without informing me or asking my opinion... frankly bad.
We are always very well attended to, and the animals are treated with great love and care. Thank you!
Very attentive.
Excellent service and care. Thank you for everything.
excelent people, they really love animals
Good professionals

All my animals have been followed here since 2022, including those I rescue from the street. I can only speak highly of everything I have experienced at AZP!
I would like to highlight my admiration for the very dear Dr. Isabel Afonso, as well as Dr. Lilianne Jorge and Dr. Célia Ribeiro, for their extensive experience, dedication, and immense professionalism.
Lovely people

A few years ago it wasn't bad, but now it's one of the worst vets! I went there urgently with my cat and they refused to admit me because supposedly they closed at 6 pm that day, even though I arrived before 5 pm. They also claimed that the "emergency slots were full," if anyone even knows what that means. And this is despite me being a client for about 10 years and paying my dues. I filed a complaint, I'll never set foot there again! I don't recommend them to anyone!
Very good service.

Incompetent to the extreme, the women at reception are the most incompetent I've ever seen in my life. They don't know what they're doing, they don't even know how to use a computer, ridiculous! I always wait at least an hour to be seen.
Nice staff and helpful. The proces are really reasonable.

On the 15th, my dog ​​needed urgent intervention, and it wasn't the ideal time for more expenses. But along the way, within AZP, a "constellation of angels" appeared, tirelessly seeking a solution for our situation (Benny's and mine). Nurse Carol was an angel on earth, appearing at that moment when we didn't know what to do and showing us that we should trust... that everything would be alright... and so it was. Thank you so much to all of you who are wonderful human beings and excellent professionals. I recommend them 100%.
The waiting time can be long, but the veterinarians are 5-star and the staff are too.
It's all very good, but then comes the "but," it's not cheap, and the parking is a lie, it doesn't exist.

It's a shame you don't answer the phone because I have several blankets to donate as winter is approaching and I believe you will need them. I wanted to know if you are willing to receive them because I don't have a car and I would be willing to take them to the address which is near my house in Lisbon.
People are very enthusiastic

I'm giving a low rating because no one answers the phone at the counter, and you're invited to leave your house just to schedule something in person. I think that's absurd for someone with a busy life.

I thought that during the consultation, although the veterinarian was kind, she seemed a bit distracted. She didn't give the proper attention. I had to keep asking her to examine my pet, take his medicine, and weigh him... I don't know if it was because it was time to leave, but I think they fell short.
A reliable place to take your dog/cat with excellent veterinarians. Making an appointment is always a challenge, whether by email or phone.

Excellent service, very attentive young veterinarians.
Become a member, consultation prices are lower.
Spectacular
Very attentive and professional.
Good service.

I was seen by "doctor" Catarina Sozinho during a recent emergency with my cat, Mi.

I went to the facility in an emergency situation, trusting in the seriousness and dedication I have always found in the association. However, this time I was seen by a veterinarian who demonstrated a lack of clinical commitment, absence of diagnostic proactivity, and a profoundly demotivating attitude. From the beginning, her approach focused almost exclusively on insisting on euthanizing the animal, without showing openness to exploring therapeutic alternatives, investing in diagnostic research, or considering a palliative care approach, even when the cat still showed signs of stability.

I felt there was no real attempt to fight for Mi's life, nor empathy for the strong bond we shared. I don't question that there are irreversible clinical situations, but the cold, repetitive, and hasty way in which euthanasia was imposed on me, even without clinical certainty, was deeply disrespectful.

I have never had problems with other professionals on your team, quite the opposite. This experience, however, left me devastated not only by the loss of Mi, but also by the way I was treated at a time of great vulnerability.

I ask that this criticism be taken into consideration, and that similar situations be avoided in the future with more humane, responsible, and empathetic training.
I was very satisfied with Dr. Claudia Ramos, an excellent professional who openly demonstrates her love for her profession! 10/10

I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with the service at AZP, which, unfortunately, has been marked on several occasions by rude attitudes and a lack of empathy.

As owners, we take our animals there with concern, affection, and often during times of great emotional stress. However, instead of feeling supported and understood, we have frequently been pressured at AZP in our decisions, without being presented with clear and respectful alternatives. Furthermore, we have noticed a complete lack of control and emotional intelligence on the part of those who communicate with us, pressuring us to make quick and difficult decisions without due care or sensitivity to our emotional state.

There have also been situations where we felt resistance in sharing all the necessary information, which further increased our insecurity. In several cases, we had to seek other professionals at other clinics to realize that the information provided at AZP did not entirely correspond to reality. We have already been inappropriately removed from the office, which made us feel disrespected, and since then we have also felt that they avoid contact with us.

The poor internal management is also reflected in the appointment scheduling—sometimes they tell us that there is no opening until a month from now, but then, when it suits them, an appointment opens up for the following week. Furthermore, we have noticed differences in how they treat people from different backgrounds, which is unacceptable in a service that should be equal for everyone.
Good

Excellent professionals, super attentive! They managed to arrange an appointment for my cat on the same day because they realized he might have a (more) serious problem. I felt they cared and wanted to know about him the whole time I was there! Not to mention that the prices are much more affordable than other places. Thank you so much for everything!
I call and no one ever answers; I even got the idea that it was closed for vacation.

A veterinary center with expertise; profit isn't their focus.

They have an in-house laboratory, which greatly simplifies diagnoses.
I recommend them.
A serious and responsible organization with a good clinical team and staff; everyone is attentive and willing to do good!

Friendly and competent. The prices are, however, more affordable than most veterinarians. It's worth becoming a member. For those with more than one pet, they offer a special price for a consultation for the second animal. I've been going there for ten years, and I have no reason to complain. I recommend them without hesitation.
Excellence, humanity in service and animal care 5***** ++

Good care and more affordable prices because it's an association. For the same reason, this veterinary clinic is very busy and usually has long waiting times. Street parking is difficult. Even so, I recommend it.
Incredible service, lots of kindness and affection, excellent professionals 🙏 …

Although I didn't have a prior appointment, there were no problems because I was treated with great attention and professionalism, especially since it was a cat captured as part of the TNR (Trap-Neuter-Return) project.
Careful, I have 4 dogs 🐕 ❤️ …
Excellent service! All the professionals were very attentive, and the entire service provided was flawless.
Good experiences. My dog ​​had surgery here and everything went well.
Fantastic!

It's very good and relatively cheap too.

A cat vaccination is 65 euros, which is good (if you're a member).

I recommend you say enough!
5-star treatment
One of the most wonderful Vetinary experiences ever. They take the time to learn and explain - and they ensure they understand the issue and history in full! Would entirely recommend!

I received terrible service! I called on a Wednesday at 12 pm, and since no one answered, I went there. It took me an hour to get there, and I arrived at 7 pm. They didn't attend to me because they were working. They told me to come back the next morning with an appointment. I arrived in the morning, and the appointment didn't show up. They told me to come back at 2 pm because it was full! I wasted an hour with my cat in a panic in the car going back and forth 3 times.
Forget it... their organization leaves much to be desired...
Very good. A lot of responsibility.
Excellent animal care, great professionals, and a reasonable price.
Very nice and helpful. Good English
Super attentive staff!
Very good vet, not a rip off unlike many vets in the Lisbon area.
Excellent team. Great professionals.
For me, one of the best considering quality-price ratio.
